issues.problem: Fiscal 2023 diluted EPS was $3.34 as reported, or about $0.33 after the 10-for-1 split, not $0.17. The $1.19 fiscal 2024 figure is split-adjusted ($11.93 as reported), so the correct comparison is $1.19 vs $0.33, an increase of about 257%.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, margins, growth rates and R&D figures all match NVIDIA's reported fiscal 2024 and 2023 results. The one error is fiscal 2023 diluted EPS, given as $0.17 when the split-adjusted figure is about $0.33.
